verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch Community Edition is confirmed MIT-licensed and its source is on GitHub, satisfying the core 'open license' requirement, but community evidence notes it is 'open core' with enterprise features gated and a contested case of a PR declined to protect a paid feature, indicating the open license doesn't cover the full product experience. Missing for 10: independent confirmation of full repository transparency/contribution practices and clarity on what portions remain closed-source.
